column1: # Number pairs in Bauman's key printed in «Переписка В. И. Ленина и редакции газеты „Искра“ с
# социал-демократическими организациями в России. 1900–1903 гг.», vol. 1 (Moscow, 1969).
# One printed group of pairs to a line. The edition prints the pairs with a slash in nos 14, 24 and 200
# and with a point in nos 73, 80, 222, 235, 318 and 336; they are written with a slash here throughout.
# Four pairs are printed with a space alone: «4 3», «15 25» and «15 24» in no. 200 (p. 243), and «5 5» in
# doc, page: number of the document and page of the volume.
# read_by: whose reading the edition prints, as its footnote says; "compilers" are the compilers of the
# printed: the reading as the edition prints it.
# pairs: the pairs as printed; 6/? is a pair printed without its second number («6/...»). The three queries
#   «(?)» that the edition prints among the pairs of no. 200 are omitted.
# expected: the letters of the printed reading, one for each pair; _ is a hard sign that modern print
#   drops, * a pair for which the printed word has no letter. Where the cipher skips letters of the
#   printed reading, they are omitted here too: the г, the д and one м of «Петербургский Международный
#   Коммерческий» in both copies of no. 200, the и of «Марковичу» in the first copy, «дом» in no. 24, and
#   the «ан» of «чемодан» in no. 80, which has five pairs.
